rows.label: qst650504_msg0001
rows.name:
You brought Nopon Challenge
Letter, Pt. 2. Does that
mean you're ready, mo?

rows.label: qst650504_msg0002
rows.name: Do I need to be ready for something?

rows.label: qst650504_msg0003
rows.name:
Taking on 'Otherworldly Fighter' and
'Poison-Poison Paradise' takes
some resolve, mo.

rows.label: qst650504_msg0004
rows.name:
Otherworldly fighter...?
Whoever they are, that does
sound like a challenge...

rows.label: qst650504_msg0005
rows.name:
I won't explain that one. You'll
have to try it and see, mo.

rows.label: qst650504_msg0006
rows.name:
But I'll give you a little
hint about 'Poison-Poison
Paradise' as a bonus, mo.

rows.label: qst650504_msg0007
rows.name:
A poisonous monster suddenly
appeared in a beautiful spring
on a certain island, mo.

rows.label: qst650504_msg0008
rows.name: A poisonous monster?

rows.label: qst650504_msg0009
rows.name:
It's called Cloud Sea Poison King
Kironex, and it turns a beautiful
spring into a deadly poison swamp, mo!

rows.label: qst650504_msg0010
rows.name:
No safe zones at all. You have to
fight both poison and enemies. It's
a very high-difficulty battle, mo!

rows.label: qst650504_msg0011
rows.name:
Well, all right, but is it
even possible to beat...?

rows.label: qst650504_msg0012
rows.name: Don't worry, mo!

rows.label: qst650504_msg0013
rows.name:
I prepared special gear
for poison swamps, mo.

rows.label: qst650504_msg0014
rows.name:
Oh, nice one! Does it work
something like a salvage suit?

rows.label: qst650504_msg0015
rows.name:
Well, not quite. Salvage suit very
constricting, cannot move freely,
so not well suited for battle.

rows.label: qst650504_msg0016
rows.name: True.

rows.label: qst650504_msg0017
rows.name:
These clothes use a special
fabric that reduces poison
and lets you move freely, mo.

rows.label: qst650504_msg0018
rows.name: And you'll just let us have them?!

rows.label: qst650504_msg0019
rows.name:
I'd like to give them away,
but the Orderly wants Finest Nopon
Crystal in exchange...

rows.label: qst650504_msg0020
rows.name: Oh, I see... Trading it is, then...

rows.label: qst650504_msg0021
rows.name: But I really want you to get them, mo!

rows.label: qst650504_msg0022
rows.name: All right, we'll do our best.

rows.label: qst650504_msg0023
rows.name: But... please don't get too angry, mo.

rows.label: qst650504_msg0024
rows.name: Huh? Why would we get angry?

rows.label: qst650504_msg0025
rows.name:
That excellent poison-reducing
fabric I mentioned is really rare...

rows.label: qst650504_msg0026
rows.name:
Even with all my resources, I
could only get a little of it, mo.

rows.label: qst650504_msg0027
rows.name:
When I made clothes for everyone
from that fabric... there wasn't
much fabric per person, mo.

rows.label: qst650504_msg0028
rows.name: Small...? How small are we talking?

rows.label: qst650504_msg0029
rows.name: About as much as a swimsuit, mo.

rows.label: qst650504_msg0030
rows.name: [ML:Feeling kind=Anger ]Swimsuit?!

rows.label: qst650504_msg0031
rows.name: Right, swimsuits, mo.

rows.label: qst650504_msg0032
rows.name: Homura and Nia in swimsuits...?

rows.label: qst650504_msg0033
rows.name: Do you want to see that too, Rex, mo?

rows.label: qst650504_msg0034
rows.name: Well, of course...

rows.label: qst650504_msg0035
rows.name:
[ML:Feeling kind=Anger ] Wait, no! They'll
definitely be mad about that!

rows.label: qst650504_msg0036
rows.name:
Calm down, Rex, mo. I'm
sure it'll be fine, mo.

rows.label: qst650504_msg0037
rows.name:
I ended up calling them swimsuits,
but the proper name is special
poison-swamp combat gear, mo.

rows.label: qst650504_msg0038
rows.name:
If you don't fight wearing it,
the poison damage is brutal, mo.

rows.label: qst650504_msg0039
rows.name:
You'll collapse in
about ten seconds, mo.

rows.label: qst650504_msg0040
rows.name:
I'm still not sure everyone
will be on board with this...

rows.label: qst650504_msg0041
rows.name:
You have to if you want to
clear the challenge, mo.

rows.label: qst650504_msg0042
rows.name: ...Right, fine.

rows.label: qst650504_msg0043
rows.name:
We'll work hard to collect Finest
Nopon Crystal and get the special
poison-swamp combat gear...

rows.label: qst650504_msg0044
rows.name:
Then I'll work hard to
convince everyone to wear the
poison-swamp combat gear...

rows.label: qst650504_msg0045
rows.name:
And we'll fight hard and defeat
Cloud Sea Poison King Kironex!

rows.label: qst650504_msg0046
rows.name: That's the spirit, mo!

rows.label: qst650504_msg0047
rows.name: Rex can definitely overcome it, mo!

rows.label: qst650504_msg0048
rows.name:
[ML:Feeling kind=Think ] For Rex's sake, I'll keep quiet
that you can manage without
the gear if you try, mo...

rows.label: qst650504_msg0049
rows.name: [ML:Feeling kind=Think ]?
